description.narrative: This indicator tracks both communication and dissemination of EO information and products/services respectively to national and regional policy institutions, initiatives and programmes. An event can be meeting, conference, workshop, seminar, etc. This includes physical, online, and/or hybrid modes. Events are a marker of the stakeholder and public engagement objective of GMES & Africa.
